title: Bathroom in the campground
content: Has anyone else been to the bathroom in the campground? I’ve been to the main one many times with the stalls, overflowing toilets, and showers which is in another section. But I am asking about the one in the campground in the forest near the river. It is smaller and when you enter it, the floors have a thick layer of feces and urine mixture about 2 inches thick. There is a big mirror and the sink/counter is covered in vomit. This is one of my recurring dreams walking through the bathroom barefoot. It is one of the most vile memorable things about the woods.
